tasks.title: Carry side in the draft marker
tasks.acceptance:
- `cr draft` renders every block's marker with `side` between `path` and `start_line`, per §7.1.1, and triage reads it back: a LEFT record's marker says `side=LEFT`, and an unchanged draft posts as rendered.
- An edited `side` is re-validated per §6.1.2 like `path`, `start_line` and `line` in §7.2's table: a LEFT-to-RIGHT edit that no longer resolves aborts with exit code 1 naming the record id, and one that resolves re-anchors. A marker missing `side` is refused with exit code 1 naming the record id and the grammar.
- Proven through the command in internal/cli tests (including a LEFT-anchored record on a deletion), with the tests pinning the old 8-field grammar updated, and go test -race -count=1 of the edited packages passes.
tasks.closed_reason:
- The §7.1.1 marker carries side between path and start_line (internal/draft/marker.go markerFieldNames, Marker.Side, markerOf, values, markerFrom), and triage reads it back: TestADraftMarkerCarriesTheSideAndAnUnchangedDraftPostsAsRendered in internal/cli/draftside_test.go drives cr record and cr draft on a LEFT record on a deletion, parses the rendered marker to the whole Marker with Side LEFT, and cr post on the unchanged draft builds the comment at lib.go 7-8 on LEFT with the stored anchor unchanged.
- An edited side is re-validated per §6.1.2 with path, start_line and line (internal/draft/edits.go markerEdit.anchor compares and re-stamps Side; ingest.go drift counts it): TestAnEditedSideIsReValidatedAgainstTheTreeItNames refuses a LEFT-to-RIGHT edit on the deleted gone.go with exit 1 and MarkerEditError{ID f1, Field anchor}, storing nothing, and re-anchors lib.go 7-8 to RIGHT with the head content hash.
- A marker missing side is refused with exit 1 by both cr draft and cr post: MalformedMarkerError now carries the record id and its message quotes the grammar, asserted as a whole value and string by TestAMarkerWithoutASideIsRefusedNamingTheRecordAndTheGrammar; no default side is assumed.
- Proven through the command in internal/cli tests including a LEFT-anchored record on a deletion, with the 8-field grammar pins updated in internal/draft/marker_test.go, internal/draft/draft_test.go, internal/cli/manualcomment_test.go and internal/cli/rulessuggest_test.go; overlay mutants of markerOf's side, the side comparison, the side assignment and the id naming each turn the new tests red, and go test -race -count=1 over the whole tree passes.
Out of scope: skills/cr/SKILL.md lines 294 and 398 still quote the eight-field marker and the old refusal text.

tasks.title: Key waivers and posted index by context
tasks.acceptance:
- The waiver key of §7.4.1 and the posted-index key of §9.3.6 hash, per §1.4, the anchor's context lines before, the anchored lines, and the context lines after, joined by LF. §9.2's anchor `content_hash` and every citation `content_hash` stay the hash of the anchored or cited lines alone. If the key cannot be computed without a new stored record field, stop and report instead of adding one.
- Proven through the command: a waived finding is still suppressed at unchanged code, and it stops being suppressed when only a context line within §9.2's window changes (for example an edit to the line after a lone `{`), the same for a posted-index entry. A waiver or posted-index entry written under the v0.1 key no longer suppresses anything and is still listed by `cr waivers list` and removable, per §7.4.4.
- go test -race -count=1 of the edited packages passes.
tasks.closed_reason:
- finding.WaiverKeyOf (internal/finding/waiver.go) now hashes, through the new finding.ContextKeyHash (internal/finding/anchor.go), the anchor's context_before, the anchored lines and its context_after joined by LF and normalised per section 1.4, and that one key feeds WaiverFor, PostedEntryFor, DropWaived and DropPosted; TestTheKeyHashIsTheContextAndTheAnchoredLinesJoinedByLF pins the pre-image.
- StampAnchor and AnchorContentHash are unchanged, so the anchor content_hash and every citation content_hash stay over the anchored or cited lines alone; TestAWaiverStopsMatchingOnceTheContextAroundTheAnchoredLinesChanges asserts the anchor hash is equal while the key differs.
- No stored field was added: a stored record keeps the window and only the hash of the anchored lines, so the key reads those lines again from the trees of the record's own head through cli.keyTrees (anchorTrees in production), and an anchor the tree cannot give lines for is refused as a state.FileError with UnusableHint.
- TestAWaiverAndAPostedEntryStopSuppressingOnceTheAnchoredLinesContextChanges (internal/cli/contextkey_test.go) records two findings, writes the waiver with cr draft from a deleted block and the posted-index entry with the writer cr post uses, then runs cr merge a round later: both drop at unchanged code and past the three-line window, and neither drops when only the line above or below the anchored lines changed; overlaying WaiverKeyOf with the v0.1 key turns exactly the two edited-window cases red.
- TestAWaiverOrPostedEntryUnderTheV01KeySuppressesNothingAndStaysRemovable seeds both scopes' waivers and a posted-index entry under the v0.1 key, and cr merge drops neither while cr waivers list --pr lists both ids and cr waivers remove deletes each; a dogfood of the built binary listed and removed a hand-seeded v0.1 waiver line.
- go test -race -count=1 over the whole tree passed through the gate lock, golangci-lint run reports 0 issues, scripts/deadcode.sh passes with deadcode at 11 lines, and Go 1.27.1 gofmt -l prints nothing.

tasks.title: Compute waiver and index keys before sending
tasks.acceptance:
- `cr post --confirm` reads every tree the §7.4.1 waiver keys of the draft's discards and the §9.3.6 posted-index keys of the payload's records need before `post_unresolved` is set and before the request. A read that fails refuses the post with exit code 3 and a hint, with no network write, no `post_unresolved`, and posted.json, findings and waivers left as they were. After a successful request cr writes the keys it already computed and reads no checkout or pull request.
- Proven through the command in internal/cli tests: with a key tree that cannot be read, the gh shim logs no POST and the round is still postable once the tree is readable. With readable trees, a post whose checkout read would fail after the request still marks the records posted, writes the waivers and the index entries, and clears `post_unresolved`. `cr post --reconcile` keeps working when it adopts a review.
- go test -race -count=1 of the edited packages passes.
tasks.closed_reason:
- cr post --confirm now forms every waiver key of the draft's discards (discardWaivers) and every posted-index entry of the payload's unposted records (postedEntries) in sending.formKeys (internal/cli/send.go), called right after the post_unresolved refusal and before posted.json, the sent sections, post_unresolved and post.Create.
- A read that fails returns the read's own error wrapped in "round N was not posted and nothing was sent", so it exits 3 with that cause's hint (git.CommandError, gh errors, state.FileError), with no gh POST and nothing written; TestAKeyTreeThatCannotBeReadRefusesThePostBeforeAnythingIsSent compares the whole state root byte for byte before and after.
- After a successful request, storeKeys writes the precomputed waivers through writeWaivers and markPosted walks the precomputed records and appends the precomputed entries through writeAdopted/appendPostedIndex, stamped with the created review id, with no tree read; TestAKeyTreeThatStopsReadingAfterTheRequestLeavesThePostWhole counts zero key reads after the POST.
- internal/cli/postkeys_test.go drives cr post --confirm with a gh shim on PATH: with the discard's or the posted record's key tree failing, the shim logs no POST, exit is 3 with the git hint, and the state root is unchanged.
- In both rows the same round then posts once the tree reads: one POST, a pull-request waiver for the discard, and one index entry for f1.
- With a tree that fails once the shim has logged the POST, the records are posted and discarded, the waiver and the index entry (review PRR_shim) are written, and post_unresolved is cleared; cr post --reconcile still forms its index at adoption through the same postedEntries and the existing reconcile tests (TestAnUnresolvedPostingIsReconciledToAnAdoptAndToAClear, reconcileownround, reconciletriage, draftunresolved) pass; all three new cases fail with the previous send.go, posted.go, reconcile.go and regenerate.go mapped in through go test -overlay.
- go test -race -count=1 ./... passed for every package under the gate lock, golangci-lint run reports 0 issues, scripts/deadcode.sh passes with deadcode ./... at 11 lines, and Go 1.27.1 gofmt -l internal cmd prints nothing.

tasks.title: Refuse protected config keys on every command
tasks.acceptance:
- Every command that resolves configuration or a profile refuses a protected setting the way `cr config` does: a config key such as `grading.argued` in any layer and a profile field such as `forcing` are refused with exit code 3 naming the file and key, on `cr record`, `cr merge`, `cr cells record`, `cr claims record`, `cr map record`, `cr waivers list`, `cr context`, `cr answer` and `cr claims set-aside`, as they already are on `cr brief`, `cr draft` and `cr post` (repro: qa-v020/results-V1a.md, D-V1a-6).
- One table-driven internal/cli test drives each of those commands with the key in a config layer and with the field in the resolved profile, and asserts the exit code and the named key. A command that resolves neither configuration nor a profile is named in the test as exempt, with the reason.
- go test -race -count=1 of the edited packages passes.
tasks.closed_reason:
- Every command now refuses a protected config key in either config layer and a protected profile field with exit 3 naming the file and the key: the root PersistentPreRunE calls refuseProtected (internal/cli/root.go), which after config.CheckEnviron runs config.CheckFile on the global config and on the per-repository config repoOf locates (internal/config/config.go) and profile.CheckDir over every profile file (internal/profile/profile.go), so cr record, cr merge, cr cells record, cr claims record, cr map record, cr waivers list, cr context, cr answer and cr claims set-aside refuse exactly as cr brief, cr draft and cr post do; dogfooded with grading.argued in the global config, where cr waivers list and cr record exit 3 with the config.json path and key, while cr --version, and cr init and cr config on a clean home, still exit 0.
- TestEveryCommandRefusesAProtectedConfigKeyOrProfileField (internal/cli/protectedsettings_test.go) is table-driven over the global config, the per-repository config and a profile file and drives every runnable command of the tree, asserting the ProtectedError name, exit 3, the message prefixed with the file and an unchanged state tree, and requires the walk to reach each command QA named; it failed 104 subtests at c5a0b06 (33 global config, 33 repository config, 38 profile), and a go test -overlay mutant skipping the repository layer turned 33 repository-config subtests red and nothing else.
- The same test names cr --version and cr --help as exempt in exemptFromProtectedSettings, with the reason that cobra answers both before any hook and reads no layer, and asserts both exit 0 with every protected file in place.
- The race suite (go test -race -count=1 over the whole module), golangci-lint, scripts/deadcode.sh and Go 1.27.1 gofmt all passed on a git archive of c1772ce, with deadcode listing 11 lines; TestNoChannelOverridesTheArguedForcing in internal/cli/unoverridable_test.go now asserts cr record and cr draft refuse the protected profile field instead of running past it.

tasks.title: Apply record's anchor rules to marker edits
tasks.acceptance:
- A marker edit to `path`, `side`, `start_line` or `line` is refused by `cr draft` exactly where `cr record` refuses the same anchor, with exit code 1 naming the record id: a LEFT anchor on a merge-base line the diff did not remove (repro D-V2-1 in qa-v020/results-V2.md) and a RIGHT anchor on a unit that only removes lines (repro D-V3-1 in qa-v020/results-V3.md), with nothing stored.
- A marker edit that `cr record` would accept is still accepted and re-anchored. Both directions are proven through `cr draft` in internal/cli tests sharing the check `cr record` uses, not a copy of it.
- go test -race -count=1 of the edited packages passes.
tasks.closed_reason:
- cr draft now refuses a marker edit to path, side, start_line or line exactly where cr record refuses the same anchor: draft.Draft carries Unchanged, which markerEdit.anchor (internal/draft/edits.go) asks of the moved anchor once it resolves, and ingestDraft supplies it as unchangedAnchors (internal/cli/anchorunit.go), which calls refuseUnchangedLines, the check cr record and cr merge run; TestAMarkerEditIsHeldToTheAnchorRulesOfRecord drives cr draft on removalHome for a LEFT anchor moved onto base line 9, a context line (D-V2-1), and a RIGHT anchor moved onto head lines 7-8 of the deletion-only unit (D-V3-1), asserting the whole MarkerEditError with record f1, the draft line and cr record's own Problem, exit 1, findings.ndjson unchanged and the draft left as saved; both subtests were red at HEAD before the change (cr draft exit 0).
- A marker edit cr record accepts is still accepted and re-anchored: the same test moves the anchor to removed base line 8, which cr record accepts, and cr draft stores LEFT 8-8 with the recomputed hash, and TestAnEditedSideIsReValidatedAgainstTheTreeItNames now moves a RIGHT anchor on longFileHome's rewrite to base line 3 and stores LEFT 3-3 with the merge-base hash.
- Both directions run through cr draft in internal/cli tests that call the shared refuseUnchangedLines rather than a copy, and each refusal subtest first takes the Problem from cr record on the same anchor; overlay mutants skipping the call or never reading the hunks for a LEFT anchor each turned these tests red, and since cr post reads the draft through the same row TestAMarkerMovedOntoALineTheDiffDidNotRemoveIsRefusedAtPost now expects that MarkerEditError.
- go test -race -count=1 over the whole tree passed through the gate lock (30 packages ok), golangci-lint run reported 0 issues, scripts/deadcode.sh passed, Go 1.27.1 gofmt -l printed nothing, and deadcode stays at 11 lines.
